interpretation.pattern: Your career is in a transitional stretch. The fundamentals hold steady, and a few focused moves could unlock real progress.
interpretation.trigger: Friction tends to appear when deadlines stack up and priorities compete for the same hours.
interpretation.cost: Ignored, small frustrations can harden into cynicism about work that still matters.

career.blindspot: During challenging career periods, avoid making reactive decisions. Give yourself at least 48 hours before responding to stressful situations.
career.actionToday: Spend 10 minutes listing what's going well in your career — not what needs fixing.
career.actionWeek: Block two 30-minute 'thinking time' slots this week — no meetings, no tasks.
career.prompt: If your career challenges right now are trying to teach you something, what would that lesson be?

interpretation.pattern: Your wealth picture is in transition. Day-to-day habits are stable, but attention to small leaks could pay off.
interpretation.trigger: Money stress tends to spike around bills, comparisons, and late-night browsing.
interpretation.cost: Left alone, money worry drains focus from the places it could actually help.

wealth.blindspot: When wealth signals are lower, avoid both panic-saving and stress-spending.
wealth.actionToday: Identify one free activity that genuinely makes you happy.
wealth.actionWeek: Have one honest conversation about money with someone you trust this week.
wealth.prompt: If you could change one financial habit tomorrow, which one would have the biggest ripple effect?
safetyNotes: For personal reflection only. This is not financial, investment, or tax guidance.

Your sun sign sits in the water element, associated with empathy, intuition, and emotional depth.

interpretation.pattern: Family life is in a transitional stretch. Bonds are stable, though a few relationships would welcome more attention.
interpretation.trigger: Distance tends to grow quietly through busy weeks and postponed conversations.
interpretation.cost: Unspoken tension tends to cost the most in the relationships you value most.

family.blindspot: During challenging family periods, remember that distance isn't always rejection. Sometimes people need space.
family.actionToday: Write down one thing you appreciate about a family member but haven't told them.
family.actionWeek: Spend 20 minutes this week on a family relationship that needs attention.
family.prompt: What's one expectation you hold for a family relationship that might be worth examining?

interpretation.pattern: Your well-being is in a transitional stretch. Routines are holding, and small adjustments could lift your energy.
interpretation.trigger: Energy dips tend to follow short nights, skipped breaks, and screens before bed.
interpretation.cost: Pushing through tiredness usually borrows energy you will need next week.

health.blindspot: Lower well-being indicators aren't predictions — they're invitations to prioritize yourself. Start with basics: sleep, hydration, movement.
health.actionToday: Go to bed 30 minutes earlier tonight. Sleep is the foundation.
health.actionWeek: Schedule a wellness check if you haven't had one recently.
health.prompt: If your body could write you a letter, what would it say?
safetyNotes: For self-awareness only. This is not medical or health guidance.

expected.monthTheme: A month of steady ground — a good time to deepen what already works.

strengths.title: Clear, structured thinking
strengths.body: Your head line reads long and well defined — a pattern linked to focus and follow-through. Plans you sketch this month tend to hold their shape.
strengths.action: Pick one idea you keep revisiting and outline the first three steps on paper.

strengths.title: A strong sense of direction
strengths.body: A well-defined fate line is read as purpose and momentum along a chosen path. Decisions about direction come easier while this signal is strong.
strengths.action: Write down where you want one project to be in three months.

strengths.title: Steady vitality
strengths.body: A clear, continuous life line is linked with steady energy and reliable routines. Your daily rhythm is an asset worth protecting right now.
strengths.action: Keep one anchor habit — a walk, a set bedtime — every day this week.

mindful.title: Naming the small distances
mindful.body: Mild distance grows in silence. A light, honest sentence usually shrinks it fast.
mindful.action: Gently name one thing you have both been avoiding.

mindful.title: The basics before the extras
mindful.body: Mid-range energy does best on fundamentals. Sleep, water, and daylight beat any clever optimization.
mindful.action: Pick the weakest basic — sleep, water, movement — and tend it first.

weekPlan: Week 1 — Career: keep it light; one small finished task beats three ambitious starts.
Week 2 — Wealth: observe before adjusting; know your numbers and let big decisions wait.
Week 3 — Family: reconnect gently; one honest, low-pressure conversation is plenty.
Week 4 — Health: go gently; favor rest, water, and daylight over intensity.
